facts.text: The host-side Tempdeck class opens the module over pyserial at 115200 baud
get_temperatures sends M105.D and returns plate1, plate2 and the heatsink temperature
M105.D replies with PT1, PT2, HST, PA1, PA2 and HSA values and OK
deactivate sends M18 and expects the reply M18 OK
M18 turns off the thermal system
M18 clears the fan manual mode and sets fan power 0, then clears the peltier target and disables the peltier
set_temperature sends 'M104 S<temp>' and expects the reply M104 OK
M104 sets a temperature target for the peltiers; its one parameter is the target temperature
set_fan_power sends 'M106 S<power>' and expects the reply M106 OK
M106 sets the fan PWM between 0 and 1; the parser refuses a value outside that range
M103.D returns the peltier current in mA, the fan RPM, the peltier PWM and the fan PWM
M103.D replies with I, R, P and F values and OK
The thermistor conversion yields a temperature in Celsius

measures.description: Peltier current in mA (I of M103.D)
measures.name: peltier_current

measures.description: Fan speed in RPM (R of M103.D)
measures.name: fan_speed

measures.description: Peltier PWM reported by M103.D, where 1 is full heat and -1 full cool
measures.name: peltier_power
